title: Why Can't We Have Nice Things with Ezra Klein | The Weekly Show
channel: The Weekly Show with Jon Stewart
summary: Jon Stewart interviews Ezra Klein about his book Abundance and why progressive goals get stuck in procedure and regulation. They discuss how to streamline government and what could be built without bureaucratic obstacles.
